assumptions: Layer.sync is the correct combinator for a synchronously-built layer (thunk form); verified against the Layer combinator table in the handbook. Effect.flip is the idiomatic way to assert a typed error in @effect/vitest tests — the result is EmployeeNotFound | RaiseTooLarge and narrowed via instanceof after the assert. The 10% cap uses strict greater-than (amount > maxAllowed), so amount === maxAllowed succeeds. Effect.fn is used for the approveRaise method body to carry a trace name, matching handbook examples.
